top_choice_rationale: P004 most closely joins a simple stochastic mechanism to quantitative predictions for fluctuations in controlled growth regimes, giving an explanation that can survive changes in microscopic realization. I retain Kardar, Zhang and Takeuchi only provisionally: full original-author history is a decisive condition, and confirmation cannot compensate for omitting an equally indispensable theorist. Geometry, preparation, finite-size and crossover tests bound the universality claim. DMFT is the strongest explanatory rival; clocks and original transmission correction are fundamental, measured inventions rather than lesser engineering. Circuit QED is mature interaction physics independently of computing promises. The observational BAO citation is appropriately bounded but does not resolve the proposed individuals' analysis-versus-survey credit. I prefer these substantive award cases to P000.
recusal_note: No direct personal or institutional link to Kardar, Zhang or Takeuchi appears in my supplied profile. Statistical-physics expertise explains my perspective but is neither a candidate-conflict finding nor automatic clearance. I disclose the Gothenburg/Chalmers environment shared with committee peers Johansson and Olsson and give their arguments no additional authority. Concrete candidate ties, if identified, require independent conflict review.
